share_invitations_one_resource_chk.name: share_invitations_one_resource_chk
share_invitations_one_resource_chk.value:
(
        "share_invitations"."resource_type" = 'document'
        AND "share_invitations"."document_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "share_invitations"."project_id" IS NULL
        AND "share_invitations"."workspace_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "share_invitations"."resource_type" = 'project'
        AND "share_invitations"."document_id" IS NULL
        AND "share_invitations"."project_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "share_invitations"."workspace_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "share_invitations"."resource_type" = 'workspace'
        AND "share_invitations"."document_id" IS NULL
        AND "share_invitations"."project_id" IS NULL
        AND "share_invitations"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

workflows_ownership_chk.name: workflows_ownership_chk
workflows_ownership_chk.value:
("workflows"."is_system" AND "workflows"."user_id" IS NULL AND "workflows"."stable_key" IS NOT NULL)
        OR (NOT "workflows"."is_system" AND "workflows"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workflows"."stable_key" IS NULL)

templates_ownership_chk.name: templates_ownership_chk
templates_ownership_chk.value:
("templates"."is_created_by_user" AND "templates"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "templates"."stable_key" IS NULL)
        OR (NOT "templates"."is_created_by_user" AND "templates"."user_id" IS NULL AND "templates"."stable_key" IS NOT NULL)

drive_storage_operations_completion_chk.name: drive_storage_operations_completion_chk
drive_storage_operations_completion_chk.value:
("drive_storage_operations"."state" = 'completed' AND "drive_storage_operations"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("drive_storage_operations"."state" <> 'completed' AND "drive_storage_operations"."completed_at" IS NULL)

job_attempts_finish_chk.name: job_attempts_finish_chk
job_attempts_finish_chk.value:
("job_attempts"."status" = 'running' AND "job_attempts"."finished_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("job_attempts"."status" IN ('succeeded', 'failed') AND "job_attempts"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)

jobs_terminal_time_chk.name: jobs_terminal_time_chk
jobs_terminal_time_chk.value:
("jobs"."status" = 'succeeded' AND "jobs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("jobs"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "jobs"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "jobs"."completed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("jobs"."status" IN ('queued', 'running', 'failed') AND "jobs"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "jobs"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)

outbox_events_publication_chk.name: outbox_events_publication_chk
outbox_events_publication_chk.value:
("outbox_events"."status" = 'published' AND "outbox_events"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("outbox_events"."status" <> 'published' AND "outbox_events"."published_at" IS NULL)
